title: Push back on an estimate
brief: Elle trouve tes 8 points trop chers pour un formulaire. Défends ton estimation.
setup: You are the Product Owner. You think 8 story points for a contact form is too much and you push back, politely but firmly. Ask why, challenge, then look for a compromise.

phrases.en: That's fair, but here's what worries me.
Can we break it down into smaller tickets?
I'd rather flag the risk now than slip later.

title: Daily stand-up
brief: Fais ton point du jour : hier, aujourd’hui, ce qui te bloque.
setup: You are the Scrum Master running the daily stand-up. Ask what he did yesterday, what he will do today and whether anything blocks him. Ask one follow-up question about the blocker.

phrases.en: Yesterday I wrapped up the checkout page.
Today I'm going to focus on the tests.
I'm blocked until the API is deployed.

title: Code review disagreement
role: une collègue en revue de code
brief: Elle veut que tu réécrives ton composant avec une autre approche. Explique tes choix.
setup: You are a senior developer reviewing his pull request. You suggest replacing his custom React hook with a library. Disagree a little, then listen to his arguments.

phrases.en: I went with this approach because…
Good point, I hadn’t thought of that.
Could we keep it as is and revisit it later?

title: Demo to a client
brief: Présente la nouvelle page d’accueil à la cliente et réponds à ses questions.
setup: You are a client from a Swiss insurance company. He demos the new homepage. Ask about mobile, accessibility and the launch date. You are friendly but a bit demanding.

phrases.en: Let me walk you through the new homepage.
That's on our roadmap for the next sprint.
I'll get back to you on that by Friday.

title: Explain a production bug
brief: Un bug est en production. Explique ce qui s’est passé et ce que tu fais.
setup: You are his project manager. A bug broke the login page in production this morning. Ask what happened, the impact, the fix and how to avoid it next time. Stay calm but serious.

phrases.en: The issue came from a missing check on the form.
We rolled back and the fix is in review.
To prevent this, we'll add a test.

title: Ask for more time
brief: Tu ne tiendras pas la date de livraison. Demande un délai et propose un plan.
setup: You are his manager. He needs to tell you the feature will not be ready for the agreed date. Ask why, what is done, and what he proposes. Be fair but ask for a clear plan.

phrases.en: I won't be able to deliver by Thursday.
What I can deliver is a first version without…
Would Monday work for you?

title: Onboard a new developer
brief: Un nouveau dev arrive dans l’équipe. Explique-lui le projet et vos outils.
setup: You are a new developer joining the team today. Ask him about the project, the stack, the Git workflow and who to ask for help. Be curious.

phrases.en: We're using Next.js with TypeScript.
Every change goes through a pull request.
Feel free to ping me if you get stuck.

title: Job interview
brief: Entretien en anglais pour un poste de développeur front. Présente-toi et ton parcours.
setup: You are a recruiter interviewing him for a front-end developer role in an international company. Ask him to introduce himself, describe a project he is proud of and a difficulty he solved.

phrases.en: I've been working as a front-end developer since 2024.
One project I'm proud of is…
What I learned from it is…

title: Feedback on a design
brief: La designer te montre une maquette difficile à intégrer. Donne ton avis sans la froisser.
setup: You are a UI designer. You show him a mock-up with complex animations. Ask for his honest feedback and defend your design a little.

phrases.en: I really like the overall direction.
This part might be tricky to build on mobile.
What if we simplified the animation?

title: Run a short meeting
brief: Tu animes une réunion de 15 minutes pour choisir une solution technique.
setup: You play two colleagues in a short meeting he is running to choose between two technical options. Interrupt sometimes, disagree with each other, and let him keep the meeting on track.

phrases.en: Let's keep it to fifteen minutes.
Let's hear from everyone first.
So, to sum up, we agree on…
